files_summary.world.json: HR domain: gmail (50 messages), slack (3 channels + 60 messages), bamboohr (70 employees across 10 depts with manager chains + 45 time-off requests).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: bamboohr_list_employees
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of BambooHR employee records, optionally filtered by department and/or employment status. It refuses requests with an unsupported status value or a department filter that does not match any known department. It also refuses requests when the BambooHR connection is not authorized to view employee directory data.

tool_schemas.name: bamboohr_get_employee
tool_schemas.description: Returns the BambooHR employee record for the given employee id. It refuses requests with a missing or blank id, or with an id that does not correspond to an employee visible to the connected BambooHR account. It also refuses access when the caller is not permitted to view that employee’s record.

tool_schemas.name: bamboohr_list_time_off
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of BambooHR time-off requests, optionally filtered by request status and/or a specific employee id. It refuses requests with an unsupported status value, or an employee_id that is not a valid/visible employee for the connected BambooHR account. It also refuses requests when the BambooHR connection is not authorized to view time-off data.

tool_schemas.name: bamboohr_decide_time_off
tool_schemas.description: Approves or denies a single time-off request by request_id and returns the updated request. It refuses requests with a missing/blank request_id, a decision other than "approved" or "denied", or a request_id that does not exist or is not visible to the connected BambooHR account. It also refuses the change when the request is not in a state that can be decided (for example, already finalized) or when the caller lacks approval permissions.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_find_email
tool_schemas.description: Returns Gmail messages that match the provided filters (from address substring, subject substring, and/or label). It refuses requests when the label is not recognized for the connected mailbox or when filter values are invalid (for example, non-string values where strings are required). It also refuses requests when the Gmail connection is not authorized to search the mailbox.

from_contains.description: Substring to match the message 'from_' address.

label.description: Label id filter, e.g. INBOX or SENT.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_get_message
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single Gmail message for the given message id. It refuses requests with a missing or blank id, or an id that does not exist in (or is not accessible from) the connected mailbox. It also refuses requests when the Gmail connection is not authorized to read message content.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_send_email
tool_schemas.description: Sends an email from the connected Gmail account and returns the created message as it appears in Sent. It refuses requests with an empty recipient list, invalid email addresses, or missing/blank subject or body. It also refuses requests when the Gmail connection is not authorized to send mail or when the message cannot be accepted for delivery as provided.

tool_schemas.name: slack_list_channels
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of channels visible to the connected Slack user/bot in the workspace. It refuses requests with a limit outside 1–200 or an invalid cursor value. It also refuses requests when the Slack connection does not have permission to list channels in the workspace.

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: slack_find_channel
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a channel by its name (without the leading #) and returns the matching channel if found. It refuses requests with a missing/blank name or a name that is not a valid Slack channel name. It also refuses requests when the Slack connection cannot access channel directory information or when no visible channel matches the provided name.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_channel_messages
tool_schemas.description: Returns messages from the specified Slack channel id. It refuses requests with a missing/blank channel_id or a channel_id that does not identify a channel visible to the connected Slack user/bot. It also refuses requests when the app is not a member of a private channel (or otherwise lacks permission) and therefore cannot read its messages.

tool_schemas.name: slack_send_channel_message
tool_schemas.description: Sends a new message to the specified Slack channel and returns the created message record as posted. Refuses requests with a missing or empty channel_id or text, or with text that is not a string. Refuses requests targeting a channel the connected Slack account cannot access or is not allowed to post in (for example, invalid channel, not a member, or posting permissions disabled).

metadata.name: Crescent HR Orchestration Hub
metadata.description: Centralizes employee and time-off data with email and chat messages to automate HR workflows, approvals, and notifications across connected workplace tools.
